newsitem.title: USA: Suit filed against Boston Chicken.
newsitem.headline: Suit filed against Boston Chicken.

text.p: Two law firms, Berger & Montague PC and Bader Villanueva & Feder PC, said Monday that they have filed a shareholder suit in U.S. District Court in Colorado, seeking damages aginst Boston Chicken Inc.

The complaint, which seeks class action status, alleges that Boston Chicken and two of its officers and directors violated federal securities laws by issuing false and misleading statements and omitting material facts regarding the company's financial results, resulting in a 60 percent drop in the price of the company's stock between August 13, 1996 and May 30.
The company faces at least two other purported class action lawsuits on similar grounds.
Representatives from Boston Chicken were not immediately avaialble for comment.
